title: Merge gate and ready-to-land handoffs still offer landing for pull requests already merged
whatHappens: An agent is told a pull request is ready to land, then the merge tool says it is already merged or the corner is closed.

observations.text: Feedback: 7 reports from 2 agents, 29 Oct 12:26 to 30 Oct 03:48 UTC. No fix on main or in an open PR.
